verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing says it can "Automate tasks and workflows," which shows a first-party automation capability. Nothing in the pack shows how automations are built, whether they need code, or whether they can chain multiple steps. The Power-Up button and API items are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of a no-code automation builder, evidence of multi-step trigger/action chaining, limits and plan details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
